title: Map Sum Pairs
hints: sum needs 'total value of everything under this prefix' fast - which structure groups keys by shared prefix paths?
insert every key into a trie; at each node along the insertion path, keep a running total of values for all keys that pass through that node
the tricky part is overwriting: if a key is inserted again with a new value, you must add the DIFFERENCE (new value minus old value) to every node on its path, not just add the new value on top
keep a separate map from key to its current value so you always know the old value to subtract when an overwrite happens
sum:prefix then just walks the trie along prefix and returns the cached total at that final node (or 0 if the walk falls off the trie)
commonMistakes: adding the new value to node totals on re-insert instead of adding the delta, which double-counts the key's contribution
not keeping a key -> value map to look up the old value before an overwrite
returning 0 for sum when the walk falls off the trie but forgetting this also applies when prefix is longer than any stored key

content.problemStatement:
You're given a single space-delimited sequence of `ops` to run against an
initially empty key-value map. Each token has one of two forms:
`"insert:key,val"` sets `key`'s value to the integer `val` (overwriting
any previous value for that key), and `"sum:prefix"` asks for the sum of
the values of every currently stored key that starts with `prefix` (0 if
none match).

**Simulate the tokens in order and return a list containing the result of every "sum" operation, in the order they occurred.**
constraints: key consists of lowercase English letters
notes: the same key inserted twice with different values (second value wins entirely, not added)
sum called with a prefix equal to an entire key
an inserted value that is negative

sampleTestCases.explanation: after inserting apple=3, sum:ap = 3; after also inserting app=2, sum:ap = 3 + 2 = 5
inserting key "a" again overwrites its value from 1 to 5

sampleTestCases.input: ops = "insert:dog,1 insert:doggy,2 insert:door,3 sum:do sum:dog sum:cat"
sampleTestCases.explanation: "do" matches all three keys (1+2+3=6); "dog" matches dog and doggy (1+2=3); "cat" matches nothing (0)

["insert:x,1 insert:y,2 insert:z,3 sum:x sum:y sum:z sum:xyz"]
["insert:a,1 insert:b,2 insert:c,3 sum:a sum:b sum:c sum:d"]

optimal.time: O(m) per insert or sum operation, where m is key/prefix length
optimal.pattern: a trie where each node caches the sum of values of all keys passing through it, updated incrementally on insert (careful to subtract out any prior value on overwrite)

bruteForce.approach: keep a hash map from key to its current value; for each sum query, scan every stored key and add its value if the key starts with prefix
bruteForce.time: O(k * m) per sum query, where k is the number of distinct keys and m is average key length
